a.xlink:title: Decodes captured stdout and process metadata into a collected ``wmc_result(Status, Value, Properties)`` term. ``Status`` is one of ``counted``, ``unsatisfiable`` (the count is zero), and ``unknown`` (no count, e.g., after a time limit or an interrupted process). ``Value`` is a number (an integer for unweighted counts, otherwise a float) or ``none``.
Parses a decimal number (optionally signed, with optional fraction and exponent, e.g., ``0.41``, ``4``, ``4.1e-01``, ``1e-5``) from character codes. Fails if the codes are not a number.
